name: macrophage expressed 1

function.text: MPEG1 encodes macrophage-expressed gene 1 protein [Cleaved into: Macrophage-expressed gene 1 protein, processed form]. Annotated molecular activities include wide pore channel activity. It participates in antibacterial innate immune response and defense response to bacterium.
